module_summary: 4-way round-robin arbiter: a double-width subtract-and-mask picks the first request at/after a rotating one-hot priority pointer, locks the grant until release, then rotates priority.

anchors.name: n0_5be
anchors.why: Two-state lock flag: freezes grant while held, cleared on release which rotates priority.

anchors.name: n6_6c8
anchors.why: One-hot round-robin priority pointer, rotated past the granted requester on release.

anchors.name: n7_889
anchors.why: Release/done input from grantee ending the locked grant and advancing priority.

anchors.name: n3_438
anchors.why: Double-width isolate-first-set result giving the winning request relative to pointer.

groups.name: Round-robin select

groups.name: Grant lock control
